Grundy Domination of Kneser Graphs and Graph Products (v3.0.0).

The paper (`GrundyPaper.pdf`, 37 pages) proves the rank bound for graphs and for strong and
direct products, determines the Grundy domination number of Kneser graphs K(n,r) whenever a
prime power at least r divides n-2r (settling the Campêlo–Severín conjecture for all but finitely
many n for each r) and of five further small Kneser graphs, determines strong tori and further
product families, shows that both product conjectures of Brešar et al. are false with largest
ratio n^(1/2+o(1)), and answers Question 1 of Brešar, Henning and Rall negatively with projective
planes. The repository holds the Lean 4 certificates (`lean/`) and the Julia checks (`julia/`, `data/`).
